# Hagioi

> An interactive map of Orthodox Christian saints. Each saint has one or more map markers (birthplace, place of martyrdom, place of relics, etc.); clicking a marker shows the saint's icon, feast day, and a short biography.

Static frontend (vanilla HTML/CSS/JS), no build step or framework, backed by a couple of small Vercel serverless functions and a static JSON data file — there is no database.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): project summary and local development setup (translations: [Greek](README.el.md), [Italian](README.it.md), [French](README.fr.md), [Spanish](README.es.md), [German](README.de.md))
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): data model, runtime conventions, and environment variables for contributors/agents working on this repo

## Data

- [public/data/saints.json](public/data/saints.json): the full list of saints, each with name, feast day, title, icon filename, bio, and one or more `{ label, lat, lng }` locations
- [public/data/saints.el.json](public/data/saints.el.json): Greek translations of saints.json (name, title, bio, location labels), keyed by saint id
- [public/assets/icons/](public/assets/icons/): saint icon images referenced by filename from saints.json, falling back to [public/assets/avatar-placeholder.svg](public/assets/avatar-placeholder.svg) when missing

## Localization

- [public/i18n.js](public/i18n.js): UI strings for English and Greek, language detection (`?lang=`, saved choice, browser language) and translation helpers; the header has a flag-based language selector

## API

- [api/v1/config.js](api/v1/config.js): returns the Google Maps API key to the client; secured via HTTP-referrer restriction on the key, not server-side auth
- [api/v1/version.js](api/v1/version.js): returns the deployed git commit (from Vercel system environment variables) shown as the version in the site footer; the site deploys continuously, so the commit is the version rather than numbered releases
